verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents an official `@browserbasehq/sdk` Node.js package for connecting to and controlling its browsers, and the SDK also manages webhook endpoints. It additionally positions Stagehand as its SDK for browser agents. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote:
the official `@browserbasehq/sdk` package is the easiest way
to connect to and control headless browsers running on Browserbase.
The SDK for browser agents. Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
You can manage endpoints from Settings as well as through the SDK.
